title: Jelly UI: Soft-body physics for native HTML form controls
summary: Jelly UI is a JavaScript library that adds soft-body physics effects to native HTML form controls, making elements like buttons, inputs, and sliders feel tactile and responsive with jelly-like animations and bounce effects.
problem_solved: Makes static HTML form controls feel more interactive and delightful through physics-based animations
why_valuable: Improves user experience by adding satisfying tactile feedback to form interactions without replacing native accessibility features
